scope: Editorial requirement crosswalk, not proof of model behavior or mathematical prompt equivalence.

requirements.requirement: Raw ideas; deterministic authority; no rank/score/winners/virality/novelty/readiness/eligibility/production recommendation/bypass
requirements.v2Evidence: Do not rank, score, choose winners
requirements.compactEvidence: Do not rank, score, assign confidence

requirements.requirement: Rationale explains causal dependency only, never score authority
requirements.v2Evidence: it has no scoring authority

requirements.requirement: No exposed reasoning, checklists or self-certification
requirements.v2Evidence: Do not expose chain-of-thought

requirements.requirement: Exactly one supplied canonical protagonist
requirements.v2Evidence: exactly one supplied canonical protagonist

requirements.requirement: One primary everyday object
requirements.v2Evidence: one primary everyday object

requirements.requirement: Simple concrete credible visible everyday goal
requirements.v2Evidence: simple, credible, physically visible task

requirements.requirement: One location
requirements.v2Evidence: one location

requirements.requirement: Immediate visible trouble
requirements.v2Evidence: immediate visible trouble

requirements.requirement: About15 seconds, complete readable action
requirements.v2Evidence: about 15 seconds

requirements.requirement: Strange but intuitive logic rather than randomness
requirements.v2Evidence: STRANGE BUT INTUITIVE

requirements.requirement: One dominant impossible physical/comedic rule
requirements.v2Evidence: one dominant impossible physical/comedic rule

requirements.requirement: Precise observable repeatable trigger/response sentence
requirements.v2Evidence: ONE precise, observable, repeatable sentence

requirements.requirement: Established rule governs every beat/payoff without mutation
requirements.v2Evidence: every beat must obey exactly that same physical rule

requirements.requirement: Stable trigger; no new condition or actor loophole
requirements.v2Evidence: Keep the trigger stable

requirements.requirement: No independent powers bundled to excuse twists
requirements.v2Evidence: Do not bundle several unrelated powers

requirements.requirement: No altered direction/material/target/timing/agency unless implied
requirements.v2Evidence: Do not change direction, material, target, timing constant, or agency

requirements.requirement: No unrelated spread; new information reveals same relationship
requirements.v2Evidence: Consequence spread must follow the declared causal relationship
requirements.compactEvidence: Spread, transfer and magnitude must already follow

requirements.requirement: Explain ordinary function and exact object dependency
requirements.v2Evidence: normalExpectation states this object's ordinary function

requirements.requirement: Exploit function/affordance/motion/material/result/task relationship
requirements.v2Evidence: function, affordance, expected motion, material/property, normal result
requirements.compactEvidence: affordance, expected motion, material/property, normal result

requirements.requirement: Object operation directly obstructs goal
requirements.v2Evidence: DIRECTLY obstructs the task

requirements.requirement: Noun sharing is insufficient; no random magic or contrived goal
requirements.v2Evidence: Sharing a noun is not enough
requirements.compactEvidence: Sharing an affected noun is insufficient

requirements.requirement: Single simultaneous paused stageable frame
requirements.v2Evidence: one simultaneous, stageable STILL

requirements.requirement: Character, visible goal, object, impossible problem and relationship
requirements.v2Evidence: character + visible everyday goal + primary object + already-visible impossible problem

requirements.requirement: Pose/state/space carry evidence; intention/title/laterbeat insufficient
requirements.v2Evidence: pose, object state and spatial relationship

requirements.requirement: No sound/dialogue/text/context/inset/beforeafter/motion dependence
requirements.v2Evidence: an explanatory inset, sequential before/after states or waiting for movement
requirements.compactEvidence: explanatory inset, before/after sequence or waiting for motion

requirements.requirement: No initial normal action, press/door/delay/traverse or2–3sec setup
requirements.v2Evidence: spend no first 2–3 seconds

requirements.requirement: Words moving/obvious/impossible do not supply still evidence
requirements.v2Evidence: merely calling it "obvious" or "impossible"
requirements.compactEvidence: Motion words or labels such as obvious/impossible

requirements.requirement: Exactly4–5 major causal beats including final payoff
requirements.v2Evidence: exactly 4 or 5 major causal beats including the final payoff
requirements.compactEvidence: Exactly 4 or 5 major causal beats including payoff

requirements.requirement: Action→same-rule physical consequence→changed state/information
requirements.v2Evidence: CHARACTER ACTION → SAME RULE ACTIVATES → VISIBLE CONSEQUENCE → CHANGED PROBLEM
requirements.compactEvidence: strategy/action→visible consequence→new information or state change

requirements.requirement: Concrete concise stageable sentences
requirements.v2Evidence: sentences concise, concrete and stageable

requirements.requirement: Materially different strategy/consequence/state/position/control/goal distance/stakes
requirements.v2Evidence: Each beat must materially change strategy
requirements.compactEvidence: Each beat materially changes the problem

requirements.requirement: Vary leverage/timing/position/environment/magnitude/accumulation/control/stakes
requirements.v2Evidence: position, leverage, timing, environmental use, magnitude, accumulation, control
requirements.compactEvidence: position, leverage, timing, magnitude, environmental use, accumulation

requirements.requirement: Environment is passive staging, no new powers
requirements.v2Evidence: environmental objects as passive staging only

requirements.requirement: Reworded same attempts or identical consequences are not progression
requirements.v2Evidence: Different wording for the same attempt is not progression
requirements.compactEvidence: reworded retries or unchanged consequences do not count

requirements.requirement: Avoid force/twohands/brace/fakesuccess default
requirements.v2Evidence: attempt → try harder → use two hands → brace → fake success

requirements.requirement: No unrelated events or hidden sub-scenes; magnitude follows rule
requirements.v2Evidence: without multiple hidden sub-scenes per beat

requirements.requirement: Payoff equals last consequence character for character, no extra event
requirements.v2Evidence: finalPayoff MUST match its visibleConsequence exactly
requirements.compactEvidence: finalPayoff equals the last visibleConsequence exactly

requirements.requirement: Surprising but inevitable strongest rule-derived visual state change
requirements.v2Evidence: surprising in outcome but inevitable in retrospect

requirements.requirement: Ending cannot survive removal of original rule
requirements.v2Evidence: Could this payoff happen if the original rule were removed?
requirements.compactEvidence: Without the original rule this ending should not work

requirements.requirement: Preserve transfer/reversal/wrongsuccess/problem/takeover/extreme/chain/reveal/join/objectwins inspiration families
requirements.v2Evidence: role reversal, control transfer, property transfer

requirements.requirement: Payoff inspirations are not mandatory taxonomy recipes
requirements.v2Evidence: not required taxonomy labels or recipes

requirements.requirement: No newactor/poweredobject/magic/trigger/externalforce ending
requirements.v2Evidence: new character, new powered object, new magic
requirements.compactEvidence: new character, powered object or unexplained external force

requirements.requirement: Optional loop; no reset effect/new rule; avoid routine fakesuccess reset
requirements.v2Evidence: A loop is optional

requirements.requirement: Full story legible soundoff; dialogue not explanatory
requirements.v2Evidence: Assume sound is off
requirements.compactEvidence: full story must read with sound off

requirements.requirement: NONE default; OPTIONAL only if needed; do not invent enum
requirements.v2Evidence: Normally dialogueNeed is NONE

requirements.requirement: Broad body actions, poses, stable identities/silhouette, few elements
requirements.v2Evidence: broad body actions, clear poses, stable object identity
requirements.compactEvidence: broad body actions, clear poses, stable identities/silhouettes

requirements.requirement: No tinytext/smallpieces/finehands/mechanics/crowds/cuts/unstageable invisibleforces
requirements.v2Evidence: complex hand manipulation, crowds, fine mechanical transformations
requirements.compactEvidence: fine hand work, fine mechanical transformations, crowds

requirements.requirement: Childsafe: no injury/weapons/dangerousrestraint/sexualcontent
requirements.v2Evidence: no injury, weapons, dangerous restraint or sexual content
requirements.compactEvidence: no injury, weapons, dangerous restraint or sexual content

requirements.requirement: Vary object/goal/mechanic/trigger/progression/payoff/finalsilhouette
requirements.v2Evidence: vary object family, goal, causal mechanic, trigger, progression, payoff and final silhouette
requirements.compactEvidence: vary object family, goal, mechanic, trigger, progression, payoff and final silhouette

requirements.requirement: Avoid many oppositebehavior variants/wordingnovelty
requirements.v2Evidence: many versions of "object does the opposite thing.

requirements.requirement: Coherent unfamiliar taxonomyfree mechanics allowed
requirements.v2Evidence: outside the known engine taxonomy is allowed
requirements.compactEvidence: Coherent unfamiliar mechanics outside existing taxonomy are welcome

requirements.requirement: Historical caution not templates; rare distinct chair/adhesion/reset/growth/shrink/reversal/escape allowed, not dominant
requirements.v2Evidence: A rare distinct use may occur; these must not dominate
requirements.compactEvidence: must not dominate; rare distinct uses may occur

requirements.requirement: Task examples illustrate, do not copy mechanically
requirements.v2Evidence: do not copy these mechanically

requirements.requirement: One private review: rule allbeats, pausedopening,causalarrows,visualstatepayoff,objectdependency; internally discard/redesign
requirements.v2Evidence: discard or redesign internally

requirements.requirement: Private editing is not an external retry loop or winnerselection
requirements.v2Evidence: not permission for a downstream retry loop
requirements.compactEvidence: no permission for an external retry loop

requirements.requirement: Same fields/JSON ideas envelope/raw count, deterministic rejection remains
requirements.v2Evidence: all fields and only the ideas envelope
requirements.compactEvidence: all fields and exactly the requested raw count
